name: @gcu/alpack
description: Dense linear algebra for the browser, compiled to WebAssembly. ALAS (BLAS equivalent: ddot, daxpy, dgemv, dgemm, sgemm, ...) + ALPACK (LAPACK equivalent: dpotrf, dgesv, dsyev, sgetrf, ...). Both f64 and f32 routines with f64x2/f32x4 SIMD + FMA + register-blocked microkernels. Runs in any Wasm runtime.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
